{
  "name": "Bug Report",
  "description": "Report a bug in Flipper Toolbox",
  "labels": ["bug"],
  "body": [
    {
      "type": "markdown",
      "attributes": {
        "value": "## Bug Report\n\nPlease describe the bug you encountered."
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "input",
      "attributes": {
        "label": "Flipper Zero Firmware Version",
        "description": "e.g. 1.5.1",
        "placeholder": "1.5.1",
        "required": true
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "input",
      "attributes": {
        "label": "Application Version",
        "description": "e.g. 0.2.0",
        "placeholder": "0.2.0",
        "required": true
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "textarea",
      "attributes": {
        "label": "Steps to Reproduce",
        "description": "Detailed steps to reproduce the bug",
        "placeholder": "1. Launch app... 2. Navigate to... 3. ..."
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "textarea",
      "attributes": {
        "label": "Expected Behavior",
        "description": "What should happen?"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "textarea",
      "attributes": {
        "label": "Actual Behavior",
        "description": "What actually happens?"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "textarea",
      "attributes": {
        "label": "Hardware Connections",
        "description": "Describe any external connections (if applicable)"
      }
    }
  ]
}
